area: Brittle Star Speed Mode and its Regatta AI
summary: Regatta now flies a trained Brittle Star drive (BrittleStarAIBoostPolicy_Regatta, its Speed Mode policy trained in Brittle Star Time with the coach off), and Speed Mode's rest multiplier goes back from x6.5 to x6 (Max 8, floor 3), undoing #2217: that raise had been compensating the untrained AI. Regatta 15 seeds: card 69.8 -> 71.3 s, L5 65.2 -> 63.0 s, both inside the 1.10x bar. Brittle Star Time Legendary at x6 (coach unchanged): I1 49.6, I2 54.3, I3 59.6, I4 84.1 s.
why: Loop step 3 gap from the step-5 audit: no trained policy anywhere for the Brittle Star.
